name: Polytrics Editorial
title: Simultaneous elections would save money, but at what cost?
text: One Nation, One Election promises lower costs and fewer months of campaign mode. But elections are also how voters hold governments to account between general elections. A state government that loses its majority would face a shorter, stranger term. Savings matter, but they shouldn't come before accountability. This is a sample post: real ones arrive through the Google Form.

name: Sample Member
title: Court hearings should be live-streamed by default
text: The Supreme Court already streams Constitution Bench hearings, and the sky hasn't fallen. Open justice is a principle, not a privilege. Streaming more courts would build trust and help law students learn. This is a sample post.

name: Sample Member
title: Every bill deserves a committee
text: Fewer bills now go to parliamentary committees than a decade ago. Committees are where members of all parties read the fine print together, away from the cameras. Sending more bills to them would make laws slower to pass but better to live with. This is a sample post.
